name: read-aloud
description: Reads Claude's replies and plans aloud, whole or just the text you selected, with a Stop button while it reads.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: The system voice's exact name (Microsoft Zira Desktop on Windows, Samantha on macOS). Empty uses the system's default voice.

speed.title: Speed (%)
speed.description: How fast to read: 100 is normal, 150 half again as fast, 75 slower. From 30 to 300.

readCode.title: Read code blocks
readCode.description: Read the contents of code blocks too. Off, each code block is announced as skipped.
